instruction: Look at tagged_cutout.step. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Create an outside Profile cutting operation and add six holding tags uniformly around the outer contour. Each tag must be 4 mm wide and 1 mm high, and the final profile bottom must be Z=0. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill for outside Profile cutting with six holding tags. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-19.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
